children: Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (NSE:RELIANCE) eyes a late‑October GDR/IPO window as refinancing and a strong downstream rally—driven by higher refining margins, surging diesel exports and planned throughput gains—boost earnings outlook alongside Jio’s near‑Rs11 lakh crore IPO plan.
Previous Week Recap
Reliance IPO Valuation, Jio Debt Payout
: RELIANCE linked to Jio Platforms IPO valued near Rs11 lakh crore; RIL’s 66.48% stake ~Rs7.45 lakh crore. IPO possibly late October; proceeds to repay ~Rs27,500 crore Jio debt. Share moves noted.
O2C EBITDA Forecast Rise
: RELIANCE traders: analysts forecast O2C EBITDA ₹20,700 crore for September (up 38% YoY), making ~73% of an expected ₹7,800 crore rise in consolidated core EBITDA to ₹53,700 crore.
Venezuela Crude Arrivals Rise
: RELIANCE received 76% of Venezuela-origin crude to India in September, routing Merey heavy, high-sulfur cargoes to Jamnagar. October arrivals could lift Venezuelan imports to about 465,000 bpd.
GDR Anchor Book Timing
: Anchor book for Reliance Industries GDR (RELIANCE) may open before Dussehra; main issue likely after Dussehra and before Oct 23, with GDR listing expected by end of October.
Jefferies Upgrades GDR Weight

: Jefferies raised Reliance Industries Ltd Sponsored GDR 144A (RELIANCE) weight in its India large‑cap model, citing attractive valuation and potential earnings upgrades from stronger refining margins.
SEZ Export-Duty Exemption
: RELIANCE: SEZ refinery’s export-duty exemption for 35.2 mtpa cuts export levies. Traders: earnings rise driven by stronger refining margins, higher throughput and improved net export realizations.
Q3 Throughput, Ethane-Cracking
: RELIANCE plans ~20 mt crude throughput in Q3, ~10% sequential rise after shutdowns. Strong ethane-crack economics may boost volumes; petrochemical spreads and LPG diversion could limit gains.
Diesel Supply Tightens Reliance
: Supply outages in West Asia, Russian refinery strikes and Chinese shipping limits tightened diesel supply, boosting Reliance Industries GDR 144A (RELIANCE) role as an international diesel supplier.
Diesel Exports To Europe Rise
: RELIANCE boosted diesel exports from Jamnagar to Europe in July, shipping its largest monthly volume in ten months, signaling higher middle-distillate outbound activity for traders to note.
Jio Satellite Tech Patents
: RELIANCE reports progress on an in-house satellite tech stack and says it has filed pre-6G patents, announced by Jio chairman Akash Ambani at India Mobile Congress 2026.
